prompt_text:
An abstract soft-focus ground. Three broad blurred orbs of light drift across a
warm off-white field: deep indigo on the left, magenta through the middle, a
cool pale sky blue on the right, bleeding into one another with no visible
seam. The light moves left to right, darkest at the left edge, palest at the
right. A fine even film grain sits over the whole frame. No subject, no
horizon, no object, no type. Flat and quiet, like a sheet of paper lit from
behind.
